decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical COMMAND ROM cartridge scanning and execution code.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte; inc/mshalo.asm is distinct from dos/mshalo.asm.
COMMAND TCODE conditionally includes this file under IBM_ROM_FIND; the saved selected-build TCODE listing includes the source and identifies ROM_SCAN and ROM_EXEC in TRANCODE.
Prior TCODE comparison covers 1212 bytes with 940 matching non-relocation bytes and seven matching internal near branches at an inferred target location (review 151).
limitations: The selected module comparison excludes relocation values and the target range is inferred. Other conditional configurations and complete COMMAND.COM linking remain unverified.
